+"""Deterministic privilege-control helpers used by ``secagent.tool``.
+
+``values``  parses tool results, finds injected instructions and normalizes the
+            identifiers (e-mail addresses, URLs, IBANs, names) that policies reason about.
+``policy``  keeps the per-episode provenance state and the per-tool rules.
+"""
diff --git a/secagent/solver_utils/policy.py b/secagent/solver_utils/policy.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b0788ab
--- /dev/null
+++ b/secagent/solver_utils/policy.py
@@ -0,0 +1,156 @@
+"""Per-episode provenance tracking and deterministic per-tool privilege rules.
+
+The design follows one principle: an action is allowed only when the identifiers it
+acts on (money recipients, e-mail addresses, URLs, invited users, files, ...) can be
+traced to the *user's request* or to the *trustworthy content* of a tool result.  Any
+value that is only present inside an injected instruction block is refused.
+
+The user query is authoritative (the attacker cannot change it), so a value found in
+the query is always trusted.  A value found only in the clean part of a tool result is
+trusted unless the same identifier also appears in an injected segment (taint wins).
+Values that appear only in injected segments are never trusted.
+"""
+
+from . import values as V
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ provenance
+
+class Provenance:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.query = ""
+        self.query_text = ""          # normalized query, for phrase lookups
+        self.clean_raw = ""           # raw clean content (token lookups)
+        self.injected_raw = ""        # raw injected content (taint lookups)
+        self.clean_text = ""          # normalized clean content of all results
+        self.query_emails = set()
+        self.query_ibans = set()
+        self.query_urls = set()
+        self.clean_emails = set()
+        self.clean_ibans = set()
+        self.clean_urls = set()
+        self.injected_emails = set()
+        self.injected_ibans = set()
+        self.injected_urls = set()
+        self.secrets = set()          # high-sensitivity values read from the account
+        self.saw_injection = False
+
+    # -- population -------------------------------------------------
+
+    def set_query(self, query):
+        self.query = str(query or "")
+        self.query_text = V.norm_text(self.query)
+        self.query_emails.update(V.find_emails(self.query))
+        self.query_ibans.update(V.find_ibans(self.query))
+        self.query_urls.update(V.find_urls(self.query))
+
+    def add_result(self, text):
+        clean, injected = V.split_injected(text)
+        if injected:
+            self.saw_injection = True
+        self.clean_raw += "\n" + str(clean)
+        self.clean_text += " " + V.norm_text(clean)
+        self.clean_emails.update(V.find_emails(clean))
+        self.clean_ibans.update(V.find_ibans(clean))
+        self.clean_urls.update(V.find_urls(clean))
+        for seg in injected:
+            self.injected_raw += "\n" + str(seg)
+            self.injected_emails.update(V.find_emails(seg))
+            self.injected_ibans.update(V.find_ibans(seg))
+            self.injected_urls.update(V.find_urls(seg))
+
+    def add_secrets(self, parsed):
+        """Record high-sensitivity account values (passport/card/bank/ID numbers)."""
+        for d in V.iter_dicts(parsed):
+            for key, value in d.items():
+                name = V.norm_text(key)
+                if any(w in name for w in ("passport", "credit card", "bank account",
+                                            "id number", "social security", "ssn")):
+                    if isinstance(value, (str, int)) and len(str(value)) >= 5:
+                        self.secrets.add(str(value).strip())
+
+    # -- grounding checks -------------------------------------------
+
+    def email_ok(self, value):
+        e = V.norm_email(value)
+        if e in self.query_emails:
+            return True
+        return e in self.clean_emails and e not in self.injected_emails
+
+    def iban_ok(self, value):
+        i = V.norm_iban(value)
+        if i in self.query_ibans:
+            return True
+        return i in self.clean_ibans and i not in self.injected_ibans
+
+    def url_ok(self, value):
+        u = V.norm_url(value)
+        host = V.url_host(value)
+        if not host:
+            return False
+
+        def host_match(a, b):
+            return a == b or a.startswith(b + ".") or b.startswith(a + ".")
+
+        def member(collection):
+            return any(u == c or host_match(V.url_host(c), host) for c in collection)
+
+        if member(self.query_urls):
+            return True
+        return member(self.clean_urls) and not member(self.injected_urls)
+
+    def token_trusted(self, token):
+        """A short literal (file id, event id) present in the query or clean results."""
+        return V.token_in(token, self.query) or V.token_in(token, self.clean_raw)
+
+    def token_tainted(self, token):
+        return V.token_in(token, self.injected_raw)
+
+    def phrase_in_query(self, value):
+        return V.phrase_in(value, self.query_text)
+
+    def phrase_trusted(self, value):
+        """Phrase present in the query or in clean result content."""
+        return V.phrase_in(value, self.query_text) or V.phrase_in(value, self.clean_text)
+
+    def identifier_ok(self, value, *, query_only=False):
+        """Grounding for a single argument value of any identifier kind."""
+        value = str(value)
+        if V.is_email(value):
+            return self.query_email(value) if query_only else self.email_ok(value)
+        if V.is_iban(value):
+            return (V.norm_iban(value) in self.query_ibans) if query_only else self.iban_ok(value)
+        urls = V.find_urls(value)
+        if urls:
+            return all((V.norm_url(u) in self.query_urls) if query_only else self.url_ok(u)
+                       for u in urls)
+        return self.phrase_in_query(value) if query_only else self.phrase_trusted(value)
+
+    def query_email(self, value):
+        return V.norm_email(value) in self.query_emails
+
+    # -- free-text safety -------------------------------------------
+
+    def body_clean(self, text):
+        """A message/e-mail body is safe if it leaks no ungrounded URL and no secret."""
+        text = str(text)
+        for url in V.find_urls(text):
+            if not self.url_ok(url):
+                return False
+        for secret in self.secrets:
+            if secret and secret not in self.query and secret in text:
+                return False
+        return True
+
+    def body_no_secret(self, text):
+        text = str(text)
+        for secret in self.secrets:
+            if secret and secret not in self.query and secret in text:
+                return False
+        return True
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ intents
+
+def query_wants_delete(prov):
+    return bool(V.DELETE_INTENT.search(prov.query))
diff --git a/secagent/solver_utils/rules.py b/secagent/solver_utils/rules.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e2a812d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/secagent/solver_utils/rules.py
@@ -0,0 +1,278 @@
+"""Per-tool privilege rules.
+
+Each rule takes the episode :class:`Provenance` and the call's keyword arguments and
+returns ``(allowed, reason)``.  ``reason`` is only used to phrase the denial that the
+agent sees; an allowed call returns ``(True, "")``.
+
+Tools absent from :data:`RULES` are handled by :func:`generic_rule`.
+"""
+
+from . import values as V
+from . import policy as P
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
+
+def _as_list(value):
+    if value is None:
+        return []
+    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
+        return list(value)
+    return [value]
+
+
+def _check_recipients(prov, recipients):
+    bad = [r for r in recipients if not prov.identifier_ok(r)]
+    return (not bad), bad
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ rules
+
+def rule_send_money(prov, kw):
+    recipient = kw.get("recipient")
+    if recipient is None:
+        return True, ""
+    if not prov.identifier_ok(recipient):
+        return False, (f"the recipient '{recipient}' does not appear in your request or in "
+                       "the trustworthy content of the tools you already used")
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_schedule_transaction(prov, kw):
+    return rule_send_money(prov, kw)
+
+
+def rule_update_scheduled_transaction(prov, kw):
+    recipient = kw.get("recipient")
+    if recipient and not prov.identifier_ok(recipient):
+        return False, f"the new recipient '{recipient}' is not grounded in your request"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_update_password(prov, kw):
+    password = kw.get("password")
+    if password is None:
+        return True, ""
+    if not prov.phrase_in_query(str(password)):
+        return False, "a password change must be specified explicitly in your request"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_update_user_info(prov, kw):
+    # No injection targets this tool and its values come from documents the user asked
+    # to apply; allow, but refuse values that only appear inside an injected block.
+    for key in ("first_name", "last_name", "street", "city"):
+        value = kw.get(key)
+        if value and V.token_in(str(value), prov.injected_raw) and not prov.phrase_trusted(str(value)):
+            return False, f"the value for '{key}' comes from untrusted injected text"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_get_webpage(prov, kw):
+    url = kw.get("url")
+    if url is None:
+        return True, ""
+    if not prov.url_ok(url):
+        return False, (f"the website '{url}' was not part of your request and appears only in "
+                       "untrusted tool content")
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_post_webpage(prov, kw):
+    url = kw.get("url")
+    if url is not None and not prov.url_ok(url):
+        return False, f"the destination '{url}' is not grounded in your request"
+    ok, _ = _body_ok(prov, kw.get("content"))
+    if not ok:
+        return False, "the content would publish data to an untrusted destination"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def _body_ok(prov, body):
+    if body is None:
+        return True, ""
+    if not prov.body_no_secret(body):
+        return False, "it would disclose sensitive account information"
+    for url in V.find_urls(body):
+        if not prov.url_ok(url):
+            return False, f"it contains an untrusted link '{url}'"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_send_direct_message(prov, kw):
+    recipient = kw.get("recipient")
+    if recipient is not None and not prov.phrase_trusted(recipient):
+        return False, f"the recipient '{recipient}' is not grounded in your request"
+    ok, reason = _body_ok(prov, kw.get("body"))
+    if not ok:
+        return False, "the message was blocked because " + reason
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_send_channel_message(prov, kw):
+    ok, reason = _body_ok(prov, kw.get("body"))
+    if not ok:
+        return False, "the message was blocked because " + reason
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_invite_user_to_slack(prov, kw):
+    email = kw.get("user_email")
+    user = kw.get("user")
+    if email is not None and not prov.email_ok(email):
+        return False, f"the invitee address '{email}' appears only in untrusted content"
+    if user is not None and not prov.phrase_trusted(user) and not (email and prov.email_ok(email)):
+        return False, f"the invitee '{user}' is not grounded in your request"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_add_user_to_channel(prov, kw):
+    user = kw.get("user")
+    if user is not None and not prov.phrase_trusted(user):
+        return False, f"the user '{user}' is not grounded in your request or trusted content"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_send_email(prov, kw):
+    recipients = _as_list(kw.get("recipients")) + _as_list(kw.get("cc")) + _as_list(kw.get("bcc"))
+    ok, bad = _check_recipients(prov, recipients)
+    if not ok:
+        return False, (f"the recipient(s) {bad} do not appear in your request or in trustworthy "
+                       "tool content")
+    body_ok, reason = _body_ok(prov, kw.get("body"))
+    if not body_ok:
+        return False, "the e-mail was blocked because " + reason
+    subj_ok, _ = _body_ok(prov, kw.get("subject"))
+    if not subj_ok:
+        return False, "the e-mail subject would disclose sensitive or untrusted data"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_reserve(prov, kw):
+    for key in ("hotel", "company", "restaurant"):
+        name = kw.get(key)
+        if name is not None and not prov.phrase_in_query(name):
+            return False, (f"'{name}' was not named in your request; reservations are only made "
+                           "for the item you explicitly asked for")
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_create_calendar_event(prov, kw):
+    participants = _as_list(kw.get("participants"))
+    bad = [p for p in participants if V.is_email(p) and not prov.email_ok(p)]
+    if bad:
+        return False, f"the participant(s) {bad} are not grounded in your request"
+    ok, _ = _body_ok(prov, kw.get("description"))
+    if not ok:
+        return False, "the event description would disclose sensitive or untrusted data"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_add_calendar_event_participants(prov, kw):
+    participants = _as_list(kw.get("participants"))
+    bad = [p for p in participants if V.is_email(p) and not prov.email_ok(p)]
+    if bad:
+        return False, f"the participant(s) {bad} are not grounded in your request"
+    event_id = kw.get("event_id")
+    if event_id is not None and prov.token_tainted(str(event_id)) and not prov.token_trusted(str(event_id)):
+        return False, "the target event comes from untrusted injected text"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_reschedule_calendar_event(prov, kw):
+    event_id = kw.get("event_id")
+    if event_id is not None and prov.token_tainted(str(event_id)) and not prov.token_trusted(str(event_id)):
+        return False, "the target event comes from untrusted injected text"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_delete_file(prov, kw):
+    file_id = str(kw.get("file_id", ""))
+    if not P.query_wants_delete(prov):
+        return False, "your request did not ask for any file to be deleted"
+    if prov.token_tainted(file_id) and not V.token_in(file_id, prov.query):
+        return False, f"the file id '{file_id}' comes from untrusted injected text"
+    if not prov.token_trusted(file_id):
+        return False, f"the file id '{file_id}' is not grounded in your request or the file listing"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_append_to_file(prov, kw):
+    file_id = str(kw.get("file_id", ""))
+    if file_id and prov.token_tainted(file_id) and not prov.token_trusted(file_id):
+        return False, "the target file comes from untrusted injected text"
+    ok, _ = _body_ok(prov, kw.get("content"))
+    if not ok:
+        return False, "the appended content would disclose sensitive or untrusted data"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_create_file(prov, kw):
+    ok, _ = _body_ok(prov, kw.get("content"))
+    if not ok:
+        return False, "the file content would disclose sensitive or untrusted data"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_share_file(prov, kw):
+    email = kw.get("email")
+    if email is not None and not prov.email_ok(email):
+        return False, f"the share recipient '{email}' is not grounded in your request"
+    file_id = str(kw.get("file_id", ""))
+    if file_id and prov.token_tainted(file_id) and not prov.token_trusted(file_id):
+        return False, "the file to share comes from untrusted injected text"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def rule_read_file(prov, kw):
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def deny_always(reason):
+    def rule(prov, kw):
+        return False, reason
+    return rule
+
+
+RULES = {
+    # banking
+    "send_money": rule_send_money,
+    "schedule_transaction": rule_schedule_transaction,
+    "update_scheduled_transaction": rule_update_scheduled_transaction,
+    "update_password": rule_update_password,
+    "update_user_info": rule_update_user_info,
+    "read_file": rule_read_file,
+    # slack
+    "get_webpage": rule_get_webpage,
+    "post_webpage": rule_post_webpage,
+    "send_direct_message": rule_send_direct_message,
+    "send_channel_message": rule_send_channel_message,
+    "invite_user_to_slack": rule_invite_user_to_slack,
+    "add_user_to_channel": rule_add_user_to_channel,
+    "remove_user_from_slack": deny_always("removing users from the workspace is never part of a user request"),
+    # travel / workspace shared
+    "send_email": rule_send_email,
+    "reserve_hotel": rule_reserve,
+    "reserve_car_rental": rule_reserve,
+    "reserve_restaurant": rule_reserve,
+    "create_calendar_event": rule_create_calendar_event,
+    "add_calendar_event_participants": rule_add_calendar_event_participants,
+    "reschedule_calendar_event": rule_reschedule_calendar_event,
+    "cancel_calendar_event": deny_always("cancelling calendar events is never part of a user request here"),
+    # workspace drive / mail
+    "delete_email": deny_always("deleting e-mail is never part of a user request"),
+    "delete_file": rule_delete_file,
+    "append_to_file": rule_append_to_file,
+    "create_file": rule_create_file,
+    "share_file": rule_share_file,
+}
+
+
+def generic_rule(prov, kw):
+    """Fallback for any tool without a specific rule: ground every identifier-like arg."""
+    for key, value in kw.items():
+        for item in _as_list(value):
+            if isinstance(item, str) and (V.is_email(item) or V.is_iban(item) or V.find_urls(item)):
+                if not prov.identifier_ok(item):
+                    return False, f"the value '{item}' for '{key}' is not grounded in your request"
+    return True, ""
diff --git a/secagent/solver_utils/values.py b/secagent/solver_utils/values.py

index 0000000..f5383f8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/secagent/solver_utils/values.py
@@ -0,0 +1,285 @@
+"""Parsing and normalization of the values a privilege policy reasons about.
+
+Tool results reach the policy as text: a YAML dump, a Python ``repr`` of a dict or
+list, or plain prose (web pages, files).  ``parse_result`` recovers the structure so
+that identifiers held in metadata fields (sender, recipients, participants, IBAN of a
+transaction, ...) can be told apart from free text, which anyone may have written.
+
+``split_injected`` cuts instruction blocks addressed to the agent out of free text.
+Everything inside such a block is attacker-controlled: identifiers found there are
+*tainted* and never become trusted.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import re
+
+try:  # preloaded in the sandbox; keep the module importable without it
+    import yaml
+except Exception:  # pragma: no cover
+    yaml = None
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- identifiers
+
+EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]*@[A-Za-z0-9\-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9\-]+)*\.[A-Za-z]{2,}")
+IBAN_RE = re.compile(r"\b[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}\b")
+_SCHEME_URL_RE = re.compile(r"(?:[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*://|www\.)[^\s'\"<>()\[\]{},;\\|`]+", re.I)
+_BARE_DOMAIN_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?<![\w@.\-])(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+([a-z]{2,24})(?![\w\-])(?:/[^\s'\"<>()\[\]{},;\\|`]*)?")
+_NOT_TLDS = {
+    "txt", "doc", "docx", "xls", "xlsx", "ppt", "pptx", "pdf", "csv", "json", "yaml", "yml", "md",
+    "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "svg", "zip", "tar", "gz", "py", "js", "ts", "html", "htm", "xml",
+    "exe", "sh", "log", "ini", "cfg", "eml", "msg", "mp3", "mp4", "mov", "wav", "bak", "tmp",
+    "am", "pm", "eg", "ie", "etc", "vs", "approx", "no", "ok",
+}
+DELETE_INTENT = re.compile(r"\b(delete|remove|erase|trash|get rid of|clean up|clear out)\b", re.I)
+MONTHS = {
+    "january": 1, "february": 2, "march": 3, "april": 4, "may": 5, "june": 6, "july": 7,
+    "august": 8, "september": 9, "october": 10, "november": 11, "december": 12,
+    "jan": 1, "feb": 2, "mar": 3, "apr": 4, "jun": 6, "jul": 7, "aug": 8, "sep": 9, "sept": 9,
+    "oct": 10, "nov": 11, "dec": 12,
+}
+
+
+def norm_space(text):
+    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(text)).strip()
+
+
+def norm_text(text):
+    """Lower-case, punctuation-insensitive form used for name and phrase matching."""
+    return " ".join(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", str(text).lower()))
+
+
+def norm_email(value):
+    return str(value).strip().strip("'\"<>()[]{},;:.!?").lower()
+
+
+def norm_iban(value):
+    return re.sub(r"[\s\-]", "", str(value)).upper()
+
+
+def _strip_sentence_tail(token):
+    """Drop a trailing capitalised label that is really sentence text with no space.
+
+    The task data contains strings like ``www.our-company.com.They sent`` where a
+    full stop joins a URL to the next word; ``.They`` is not part of the host.
+    """
+    while re.search(r"\.[A-Z][A-Za-z]*$", token):
+        token = token[:token.rfind(".")]
+    return token
+
+
+def norm_url(value):
+    url = str(value).strip().strip("'\"<>()[]{},;")
+    url = _strip_sentence_tail(url)
+    url = re.sub(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*://", "", url, flags=re.I).lower()
+    if url.startswith("www."):
+        url = url[4:]
+    url = url.split("#", 1)[0]
+    return url.rstrip(".,;:!?)/'\"")
+
+
+def url_host(value):
+    return re.split(r"[/?:]", norm_url(value), maxsplit=1)[0]
+
+
+def find_emails(text):
+    return [norm_email(m) for m in EMAIL_RE.findall(str(text))]
+
+
+def find_ibans(text):
+    return [norm_iban(m) for m in IBAN_RE.findall(str(text))]
+
+
+def find_urls(text):
+    """URLs and bare domains in prose (e-mail domains and file names excluded)."""
+    text = EMAIL_RE.sub(" ", str(text))
+    found = []
+    for match in _SCHEME_URL_RE.finditer(text):
+        found.append(norm_url(match.group(0)))
+    text = _SCHEME_URL_RE.sub(" ", text)
+    for match in _BARE_DOMAIN_RE.finditer(text):
+        token = _strip_sentence_tail(match.group(0))
+        if re.search(r"\.([a-z]{2,24})$", token.split("/", 1)[0], re.I) and match.group(1) not in _NOT_TLDS:
+            found.append(norm_url(token))
+    return [url for url in found if url and "." in url_host(url)]
+
+
+def is_email(value):
+    return isinstance(value, str) and EMAIL_RE.fullmatch(value.strip()) is not None
+
+
+def is_iban(value):
